aiRecommendations.title: Recommendations
aiRecommendations.regularBrushingDesc: Brush your teeth at least twice a day for 2 minutes. Use a soft-bristled toothbrush and replace it every 3 months.
aiRecommendations.flossDesc: Use dental floss or an irrigator daily to clean between teeth where a brush can't reach.
aiRecommendations.dietDesc: Limit sugary and acidic foods. Drink water after meals to rinse away food residue.
aiRecommendations.dentistVisitsDesc: Visit a dentist every 6 months for professional cleaning and check-up, even if nothing bothers you.
